items.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
items.description_zh: 避免常见的 App Store 和 Google Play 拒绝。开放剧本和提交前保护，包含 124 个记录的拒绝模式和修复、隐私清单和数据安全检查、112 个跟踪的截止日期（欧盟人工智能法案、DSA、COPPA、年龄法）以及人工智能编码代理的技能。
